summary: Ansible 13.7 hitachivantara.vspone_block breaking changes: renamed parameters in hv_gad (mirror_unit_number), hv_hg and hv_iscsi_target (nickname, port_ids, port_id, should_delete_all_volumes), hv_hur (mirror_unit_number, primary_journal_id, secondary_journal_id), hv_ldev (parity_group_id), hv_resource_group (begin_ldev_id, end_ldev_id, parity_group_ids) and hv_sds_block_compute_port.
